en: The Dhāraṇī of Avalokiteśvara Hayagrīva.
Homage to the Triple Gem!
Homage to the noble Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Avalokiteśvara, the Great Compassionate One!
Homage to the destroyer of the misfortunes of all sentient beings! Homage to the remover of the misfortunes of all sentient beings! Homage to the one who delivers all sentient beings from fear!
Homage to the one who pacifies all states of existence! Homage to the one who provides the healing medicine of awakening for all sentient beings! Homage to the one devoted to severing all bonds!
Homage to the one who effects liberation from all suffering! Homage to the one who dispels all darkness!
Homage to the Lord of Yogins of the Great Yoga, who has attained mastery over all kings of vidyās!

Having paid homage to him, I shall now recite this supreme heart-mantra of Hayagrīva-Brahmā, which issues from the mouth of the noble Avalokiteśvara, and which is honored by sages, gods, nāgas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, Śakra, Brahmā, the world-protectors, Viṣṇu, Maheśvara, Nārāyaṇa, Skanda, Kubera, the lord of asuras, and the host of Mothers— a mantra as sharp as a diamond razor.

It accomplishes immeasurable aims, is unassailable by all beings, and destroys all obstacles. It is unfailing in all rites and the dispeller of poisons. It is as follows: *Oṃ tarula tarula vitarula vitarula, O destroyer of all poisons, O driver away of all spirits, O you whose body is adorned with a mane and who laughs loudly amidst blazing sparks of fire, O you who are severed by the vajra-sickle!*

O Buddha who causes the surface of the earth to tremble, who causes the ocean to surge, who brings laughter to the Maruts and heals their wounds, who devours the obstacles created by others’ wickedness, who bestows the instruction of one’s own vidyā, and who grants supreme peace—
Buddha, Buddha, may I awaken! O Blessed One Hayagrīva, I shall recite the heart-mantra of all vidyās.
Eat, eat! by means of the great and terrible mantra.
Protect, protect! by means of the mantra for the benefit of oneself and one's own.
Accomplish, accomplish! grant, grant success to me in all rites!

Possession! Possession! Entry! Entry! Unimpeded among all seizing spirits! Shake! Shake! Tremble! Tremble! Churn! Churn! Destroy! Destroy! Subdue! Subdue! O you who have overcome all excellent strongholds!
You who have performed the khorda-rite!
O invincible rat!
O poison-clawed, poison-fanged one, you who prepare the powder of poison and the performance of malevolent sorcery! Accomplish this! O collyrium that deludes the eyes!

O agitator of the mind! O you who are ever looking at others! Terrify, terrify! O Great Bodhisattva with powerful fangs! Protect, protect all beings from all fears! Perform quickly, perform quickly my task authorized by the Buddha, Dharma, and Saṅgha! Phaṭ!
Phaṭ to Hayagrīva!
Phaṭ to Vajrakṣura! Phaṭ to Vajradaṃṣṭrotkaṭabhayabhairava!
Phaṭ! To the one who destroys the counsel of others, phaṭ! To the one who completely devours the wicked obstacles of others, phaṭ!
To the one who eradicates all seizing spirits, phaṭ!

Phaṭ! To the one who is unimpeded among all seizing spirits, phaṭ! To the one with the face of a chapter (paṭala), phaṭ! To those whoever they may be who desire my harm—who step upon my body, who restrain me with mantras, who perform fire-sacrifices, or who practice kākhorda—[to them, phaṭ!]
With all that [power] directed toward [the enemy], *ākṛṣyāya phaṭ*.
Homage to Hayagrīva, the eradicator of all evil grahas; may [these] mantra-words be effective, *svāhā*.
*Oṃ amitodbhavāya hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā*.
Oṃ, homage to the horse, svāhā!
Oṃ, homage to the one whose form is the universe, svāhā!
Homage to all sentient beings; may the words of the mantra be effective, svāhā!
